AnalysisReport.description:
Versioned, human-facing analysis report metadata.

This is a non-authoritative, bounded presentation projection emitted by a
report surface such as the `summary` command. Stage integrity is established
by [`crate::AnalysisStageReceipt`] and [`crate::AnalysisSummaryDocument`];
large or independently versioned data remains in artifacts referenced by ID.

artifacts.description: References to the authoritative report artifacts.

health_verdict.description: Health verdict that gates interpretation of the report.

Artifact.description: One immutable file artifact and its provenance.

id.description: Stable artifact identifier unique within the session.

input_artifact_ids.description: Artifact identifiers consumed to produce this artifact.

kind.description: Extensible artifact kind such as `raw_trace` or `perfetto`.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the file.

producer.description: Tool or stage identifier that produced the file.

relative_path.description: Canonical path relative to the session directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the complete file.

CaptureInstrumentationConfig.description: Target instrumentation method and independently measured incremental cost.

method.description: Versioned target-side API or marker method, such as `t32perf-c-wire/v1`.

overhead.description: Controlled measurement used to quantify incremental instrumentation cost.

CaptureInstrumentationOverhead.description:
One controlled measurement of target-side instrumentation overhead.

The incremental cost is `instrumented_duration_ns - baseline_duration_ns`.
Keeping both source durations and the emitted-event count avoids a rounded
floating-point average in the authoritative contract.

baseline_duration_ns.description: Duration of the uninstrumented reference workload.

emitted_event_count.description: Number of target events emitted during the instrumented workload.

evidence_artifact_id.description: Immutable artifact containing raw measurement evidence.

instrumented_duration_ns.description: Duration of the same workload with instrumentation enabled.

oneOf.description: At least one material improvement and no regression were found.
No material regression or improvement was found.
At least one material regression was found.
Health or metric support prevents strict comparison.

oneOf.description: An RTOS task or thread.

A core-level context used when no finer attribution exists.
A context whose precise kind is unavailable.

FunctionHotspot.description: Aggregated active-time metrics for a function and optional context.

context_id.description: Context dictionary identifier when the report is context-partitioned.

inclusive_active_ns.description: Inclusive active time across all activations.

incomplete_count.description: Number of activations reconstructed from incomplete boundaries.

max_active_ns.description: Maximum active duration of one activation.

min_active_ns.description: Minimum active duration of one activation.

self_active_ns.description: Self active time across all activations.

oneOf.description: Quantitative results and strict comparisons are permitted.

MetricSupportLevel.description: The support level for one analysis metric.

oneOf.description: The capture directly supports exact computation.
The metric can be deterministically inferred with documented caveats.
